lines.en: : Now that you’ve all had an hour or two to get acclimated and learn about how this year’s Dorm Wars-Slash-Sports Day is going to work, I’d like to open the floor to anyone who might have any questions!
: Miss Imani! Did you know that some people do it in the butt?!
: I would now like to close the floor and thank you all for your questions!
: Way to go, Miku. Now I’ll never know what topics will be covered by the trivia contest and I’ll have to get utterly decimated by Nodoka again.
: I’d be willing to take a fall for a certain price, dearest Makoto.
: Why would we pay when we’ve all gotten to see that for free already?
: Attention! I’m the one in charge here! Which means that everybody has to listen to me! Thanks!
: As you’ve all likely noticed by now, I’m joined today by Class B’s very own Wakana Watabe. Or, as they call her in every other classroom, the hot goth teacher.
: That is Miss Hot Goth Teacher to the lot of you miscreants. Thank you for your cooperation.
: Wakana will be popping in throughout the competition to both make sure that I am doing my job and to make sure that all of you guys are happy! Because, believe it or not, she loves you!

: I do not love them. My livelihood simply hinges on the fact that they need to continue coming here or the school is going to downsize and I’m going to have to ask my parents for financial assistance.
: Speaking of parents, has anybody seen Rika? She did go over all the contests with you, right?
: I know absolutely no one who goes by that name.
: She did, don’t worry. And you’ll probably be happy to hear that she read the script you made basically word-for-word. Perhaps almost...too word-for-word.
: Imani, are you still accepting questions? Because I’m really confused about something.
: Yeah, sure. What’s up?
: Who are they?
: Excellent question, Rin!
: I have absolutely no clue.
: But they're clearly breaking the “no boys allowed” rule and better have a damn good explanation as to why!
: That’s Good Kid! They’re friends of mine and got really into the Dorm Wars during the Halloween broadcast. So I figured I’d ask them to come give us a live soundtrack this year!
: But...they’re white.
: Are you a racist now too, Molly?
: What?! No! I just don’t understand why they’re here in Kumon-mi! Because they’re clearly Canadian and obviously not with that one group of Europeans we’ve encountered.
: Can people be clearly Canadian?
: Oh, they got trapped inside the wall during a tour and now they can’t leave until everyone comes back from space. They love it, though.
: I feel like they’d kind of have to if they’re going to volunteer to play a free concert at some high school sports day.
: What’s even better is that all of their music is totally royalty free! All they want in return for it is to be credited!
: Why would you say that?!
: Don’t you understand that this just means someone else is going to come along and do this now?! Don’t let them steal our soundtrack! You’re enabling lazy h-game developers everywhere!
: Oh, stop. As if anyone would ever copy us.
: That’s right, Futaba. I’m sure that anyone watching at home right now would never do something like that.
: Exactly. And if the four of us just happened to be characters in some video game, I’m sure no one would ever go into the game’s code and copy our menus and UI to pass off as their own.
: Or take our music.
: Or our logo.
: Or the naming convention of our city.
: Or key plot points.
: Or character designs.
: Yeah. Maybe you’re right, Rin. You’d have to be a real lich to do something like that.
: But at least you could hide behind the mask of “inspired by” to compensate for and excuse your overwhelming lack of creativity while quietly praying someone will find your knockoff first.
: Imani, just how long do you intend to let them carry on this ridiculous hypothetical scenario for?
: Huh? Did you say something? I couldn’t hear you over that poppy, rocky Good Kid goodness and was too busy following them on Spotify to listen to you.
: Can you put your phone down now or am I going to have to rebuild the fourth wall myself?
: Hah. Fine. Fun time’s over, I guess.
: The name of our first game is Egg Time Madness! Or just “egg toss” if you want to be boring and uncreative!

: The rules are simple and I’m sure you’ve all played this at least once before, but I’ll go ahead and explain them again for anyone named Touka or Yasu who only recently started talking to real humans.
: Oh, thank goodness. I was very concerned for...for Yasu. I obviously know about Egg Time Madness.
: Who’s your favorite Egg Time player, Touka?
: N...Number seven. From the...from the black team.
: Imani, how do you manage to deal with these girls on a near-daily basis?
: You learn to just tune them out sometimes. But anyway! Rules!
: Two teams of two, one from each floor, will take an egg from Wakana and simply throw that egg back and forth until someone drops it!
: Whoever’s egg stays alive until the end gains a point and takes an early lead in the competition!
: A...Alive? Are there actually-
: Poor choice of words. I bought these eggs from the store. They’re probably not alive. Probably. And if they are, you’ll be pleased to know I kept the receipt and can get my money back.
: I don’t think that’s what Sana’s worried about...
: Now! Which brave combatants are going to be taking the stage first?! And by “stage” I mean dirt. Not even Good Kid gets a stage and they just hit two million followers on Spotify.
: Futaba, can you be my partner for the egg tossing competition?
: All of the other girls have really tiny hands and I need someone who both excels at protecting things and also has a nurturing presence. I think you’d be really good at it.
: Woah. Did anyone else get really intense deja vu just now?
: I volunteer myself! And I also volunteer Sana!
: What?!
: Noooooo my egg!
: Ayane and Sana to the dirt stage! Floor two — choose your fighters!
: As if it was ever a choice at all!
: Why am I here?!
: Because, Sana! Everyone always forgets we’re the best of friends and we must seize opportunities like this to remind them all of our combined power!
: But I don’t have any power! I can’t even open the door to the storage room! It’s too heavy!
: I eat doors for breakfast. Noodle doors. Prepare to die, Zagull Throat Bitch.
: That’s not even the right fake name!
: Wait. Are you sure you want to compete in this game, Tsuneyo? Doesn’t your experience lie with, like...killing chickens?
: These are not chickens. These are eggs. They came first. I must protect them so that I may one day harvest their meat for ingredients.
: You dare challenge the Tenderheart Twins? The most esteemed duo of protectors the western leyline has ever seen?
: Tsuneyo, these eggs will never grow into chickens. They’re okay to break.
: I have been deceived.
: D-Don’t listen to her, Kendo Princess! She’s a saboteur! This is all a desperate attempt to debuff our party before the contest begins!
: No offense, but...you two don’t really...look like twins either...
: Egad! They’re both saboteurs! New battle plan, Ram! We’ll focus on curse removal! It’s the only way to combat them!
: I thought you were better than this, Zagull Neck Sword.
: Come, Emerald Guardian. Let us receive our future child from Miss Hot Goth Teacher.
: For the Tenderhearts! For Ireland!
: This shouldn’t be very hard.
: Yeah, I think we’ll be okay.
: Places, ladies! At least five yards apart!
: We must find more yards, Guardian. I am only aware of the one in front of the school.
: Is here okay, Miss Imai?
: Yeah, you guys are good. Molly! Further back!
: My arms are weak! I demand a handicap!
: I still can not find a second yard. We may have to forfeit at this rate.
: Um...I have the egg. When do we start-
: Five!
: Oh no! So soon!
: Four!
: It’s okay, Sana! Just like we practiced!
: Three!
: We’ve never practiced this before!
: Two!
: Guardian! I will throw the egg as far as I can and hope that it passes more yards along the way!
: One!
: Not those kinds of yards, Tsuneyo! Just throw the egg to me!
: Go! Egg Time Madness!
: Egg Time Madness!
: Fly!
: Ah! Ah! Ah! Egg! Help!
: Where is it?! Where is it?! It’s blending in with the clouds! It’s-
: Wait. It’s not blending in at all. I can’t see the egg because it’s invisible!
: Of course the Dark Successor would add a twist to such a well-known game. It would be far too easy otherwise! But to think she could get her hands on...Dwarven...egg technology! What a plot twist!
: If the egg is invisible, there is only one way to catch it. I must feel the egg. I must be the egg.
: And an egg...my egg...
: ...Would appear before me now!
: Holy shit, that worked.
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!!!
: Sana! Not so hard!
: We have to be gentle with the-
: We have to be gentle with the egg or we’re going to wind up breaking it. Try throwing it underhand. Don’t just whip it at me.
: It won’t make it to you if I underhand it! Stop assuming I have normal girl strength!
: Zagull would never say anything so weak! Would he, Sana?
: Zagull wouldn’t throw eggs in the first place!
: Well, he would if he still had his dominant hand! So I don’t want to hear you make excuses anymore! Especially not while the Tenderheart Twins are somehow still in this thing!
: I’m trying, okay?! You’re the one who volunteered me for this!
: Because I believe in you!
: The same reason I believe in this egg.
: When we’re born, we’re all defenseless little things. And it’s the people who throw us that make us who we are.
: It’s the little dreams...like this tiny white ball...and the yellow yolk inside of it that propel us to success.
: And whenever I hold it in my hands like this...it’s like I’m looking at my future.
: What?!
: Ayane! Stop stalling with weird improvised monologues or you’re going to be disqualified!
: I did all I could, Sana! Here comes the future!
: Don’t just throw time at me!
: That’s going to happen whether you like it or not!
: What does that even mean?!
: You’ll find out eventually! Just catch the-
: Egg...caught!
: Now, monologue! Quick!
: When I...look at the egg, I...I see an egg...
: Throw the damn egg, girl!
: Egg Time Madness!
: Egg Time Madness!!!!
: Egg Time Madness!!!!!
: Egg Time Madness?!?!?!?
: Egg Time Madness.
: Try again, Rin.
: Sorry, what I meant to say is- when can we find out what death ball is? Because we’re trying to figure out who is going to compete in what and-
: You’re trying to figure out which girls would be missed the least in the event of an accidental sacrifice?
: Please at least spare Miyamura.
: What? No. None of us want to be sacrificed.
: I mean...no one ever wants to be sacrificed.
: We just want to know...what sort of game we should be preparing for. What types of strengths to...incorporate in the team we come up with.
: You mean you guys, like...you’re actually trying? Even though there’s not really any reason to this year?
: Of course there is. You worked really hard putting all of this together for us, didn’t you?
: You’ve been busting your butt ever since Sensei left. That isn’t lost on us, Miss Imai. The very least we can do is take this event seriously since we know you’re doing it for us.
: Futaba’s right! We love you and appreciate everything you do for us. Even if you might make us sacrifice one another later.
: Oh, no...I’m gonna cry...Please don’t look at me.
: If I wasn’t so dead inside, I’d probably be smiling right now.
: You are smiling right now, Miss Watabe.
: No talking back to teachers, Fukuyama. I’ll see you in detention on Monday.
: D...Detention? Is that...do...do we have that here?...
: Not nearly as often as we should.
: Egg Time Madness!
: Egg Time Madness!!!!
: Egg Time Madness!!!!!
: Monologue-free Egg Time Madness!
: Egg Time-
: Geh!
That perfect spring day was the last time Sana Sakakibara would ever open her eyes.
As she collapsed to the ground, her friends rushed to her aid and circled her body.
They lifted her up in hopes that they’d be able to save her life...
But alas-
The school nurse is off on Fridays.
She is survived by her mother, Sara Sakakibara, and one other.
She will be buried next to her brother.
Ayane Amamiya never forgave herself for what happened that day.
She wound up turning herself in to the police shortly after this for the murder of her best friend and several janitors.
The police, having no record of the janitors ever having existed, gave her a light sentence.
She served five years in prison and is now out on parole, working at her father’s bubble-wrap factory.
She is no longer in contact with anyone.
Molly.
Tsuneyo Tojo, still confused about why she had to be escorted off the street by a classmate, stared at the chickenless egg in her hand and had a thought.
But the thought was complicated, and this was not the place to be having it.
It had something to do with spiders. Maybe wires. Maybe another recurring symbol that, while confusing to her, would make more sense to someone like you.
And then you stared at the egg as well.
And the egg stared back at you.
Then Tsuneyo stared back at you.
Then the first contest came to an end.
Floor 1: 0\nFloor 2: 1
